hooks.name: protect-derived-projections
hooks.command: p=$(for c in "${ACD_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/plugins/acd" "${HOME:-}/.openhands/plugins/installed/acd"; do [ -d "$c/hooks/scripts" ] && printf %s "$c" && break; done); [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "acd plugin root unresolved: hooks/scripts/protect_projections.py" >&2; exit 2; }; exec python3 "${p}/hooks/scripts/protect_projections.py"
